entries.title: James 3:6
segments: Which defileth the whole body. Compare the words of Jesus (Mt 15.18-20): 'But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.  For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murder, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings: these are the things which defile the man.
